summary: Astronauts can't see a doctor when they're in space. What if you had one right next to you, at all times, personalized based on your medical history? We built a solution that addresses this issue. Our prototype doesn't get tired, is always available and it makes research based assessments of an astronaut's health, provides detailed metrics and hard to see correlations between them. With this project, we hope to revolutionize the existing solutions by making them more user-friendly and flexible.
details:
Astronauts can't see a doctor when they're in space. We built one that sits next to them at all times: HydroGraph is a mission-medical dashboard that never gets tired, is always available,

and makes research-based assessments of an astronaut's health — surfacing detailed metrics and the correlations between them that are hard to see by eye.
